title: Not Ready Yet
can_do: 在不想立刻停止时说出感受，并具体说明还需要完成什么。
trigger: Dad announces cleanup while the block house is missing only its red roof, so Child states his not-yet boundary and names the piece he still needs.
essential_props: one block-house set with a final red roof piece and its storage box

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Cleanup time. Let's put the blocks away.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: I don't want to stop yet.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The roof. The red piece goes on top.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: One last piece, then we clean up.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Deal. Roof first, then tidy up.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Now I'm ready to clean up.

replay_cards.title: Finish the picture
replay_cards.change: The last wheel still needs color
replay_cards.challenge: Mom calls for bath time; name the one visible part to finish, finish it, and go

replay_cards.title: End the train game
replay_cards.change: The train is one stop from the station, but Dad thinks Child means another full trip
replay_cards.challenge: Dad calls for lunch. Child names one last stop; when Dad checks whether he means another trip, Child repairs, "I mean the station stop, then I'll come." Dad accepts that visible endpoint. Child arrives at the station, then puts the train away and comes to lunch.

parent_support: Ask what remains instead of guessing.
Agree only to a short, visible finish point and calmly keep the cleanup boundary.
